Field.Label: I have an Octopus Home Mini:
Field.Description: Enable to fetch live "today" usage and cost (and live demand) from your Home Mini every 5 minutes. Requires an Account device.

Field.Label: Find your API key at: https://octopus.energy/dashboard/new/accounts/personal-details/api-access After entering your API key and saving, create an Account device which will auto-discover your account details.

Octopus Energy Plugin for Indigo v2.2.18 Comprehensive energy management with REST and GraphQL APIs
Core Features: • Real-time electricity and gas consumption tracking • Live tariff rate monitoring with automatic change detection • Historical data tracking (day-by-day monthly consumption) • Cheap rate period detection for EV charging automation • Export meter support for solar generation • Dual-register meter support (Economy 7, Intelligent Go)
GraphQL Features (requires email/password): • Account balance and payment information • Saving Sessions (free electricity events) tracking • Automatic triggers for session start/end • Intelligent Octopus EV charging schedules (coming soon)
Automation: • 13 triggers for comprehensive home automation • Saving Sessions integration for consumption reduction • Rate-based EV charging control
Visit: https://developer.octopus.energy/
